object.attr: analysis: as built, the PDF program and the figure program each stop at 300 s, about 600 s in all, and the message blames the network (CF-P55). Measured from the export start, awake time only (review Q13, decided on 2026-11-11); MELLON-PDF-SRS-43 ends the programs. Functional, not Quality (review Q61). Whether the limit grows with document size is open.
object.description: If an export hasn't ended 300 s after the export start, counting only time the computer is awake, Mellon shall stop the export and report that the export didn't end within 300 s.
